answer: Use a time-locked stake auction for identity slots. Each epoch the registry opens a fixed number of slots, and applicants bid tokens locked for ninety days under their key. The lowest winning bid sets a uniform clearing price, so every added fake raises the price for all. A quill signs each bid; slashing burns the stake if audits find collusion. Holding one orchard of fifty fakes ties up fifty stakes, about forty dollars each in lost yield, while a terrace of honest agents pays once.
